name: Staff of the Sands
body:
Aura strong divination; CL 15th; Slot none; Price 136,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This perfectly-smoothed and elongated rod of sandstone is flecked with mica. The staff allows use of the following spells:

haste (1 charge)
slow (1 charge)
modify memory (2 charges)
moment of prescience (3 charges)

The bearer can also apply the Quicken Spell feat to qualifying spells by expending a number of charges equal to that spell’s level (minimum 1).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Staff, Quicken Spell; Spells haste, modify memory, moment of prescience, slow; Cost 68,000 gp
